report.markdown:
# Incident report: Why are orders timing out in production?

- **Investigation:** inv-demo-s3 (INC-1103)
- **Service:** order-service · **Environment:** production
- **Severity:** high · **Confidence:** 84%
- **Affected services:** order-service, inventory-service

## Summary

Orders time out because inventory-service became slow. Its v1.4.2 migration dropped the stock_levels index, so stock lookups take 3–5 s and order-service's 3 s client timeout returns HTTP 504.

## Root cause

Slow stock_levels queries in inventory-service v1.4.2 (idx_stock_levels_sku dropped) make order-service calls exceed their 3 s timeout, returning HTTP 504. _(confidence 84%)_

### Supporting evidence

- `ev-s3-logs-2` (log, elasticsearch): 132 'slow query on stock_levels' warnings in inventory-service (3–5 s each) [link](http://localhost:5601/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-26T10:45:00Z',to:'2026-09-26T11:15:00Z'))&_a=(index:'inventory-prod-*',query:(language:kuery,query:'FROM%20inventory-prod-*%20%7C%20WHERE%20message%20LIKE%20%22slow%20query*%22')))
- `ev-s3-metrics-1` (metric, prometheus): order-service p95 0.12 s → 3.1 s (capped by the 3 s client timeout) [link](http://localhost:3000/d/service-overview/service-overview?var-service=order-service&from=1790419500000&to=1790421300000&viewPanel=Latency%20p95)
- `ev-s3-code-1` (commit, git): Commit 3c6b3f4 'migrate stock_levels indexes' drops idx_stock_levels_sku
- `ev-s3-k8s-1` (k8s_event, kubernetes): inventory-service rolled out revision 9 (v1.4.2) at 10:55Z [link](http://localhost:3000/d/k8s-workloads/k8s-workloads?var-deployment=inventory-service&from=1790419500000&to=1790421300000)
- `ev-s3-logs-1` (log, elasticsearch): 57 upstream timeouts calling inventory-service GET /api/v1/stock (HTTP 504) [link](http://localhost:5601/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-26T10:45:00Z',to:'2026-09-26T11:15:00Z'))&_a=(index:'order-prod-*',query:(language:kuery,query:'FROM%20order-prod-*%20%7C%20STATS%20count%20BY%20pattern')))
- `ev-s3-alerts-1` (alert, alertmanager): HighLatencyP95 (warning) on inventory-service since 10:57Z [link](http://localhost:9093/#/alerts?filter=%7Balertname%3D%22HighLatencyP95%22%7D)

## Impact

HTTP 504 on order creation for ~11% of requests since 10:58Z.

## Timeline (UTC)

- 10:55:00 inventory-service v1.4.2 rolled out _(k8s)_
- 10:56:02 First slow stock_levels query _(logs)_
- 10:57:00 HighLatencyP95 fires on inventory-service _(alerts)_
- 10:58:21 First order-service upstream timeout (504) _(logs)_
- 11:00:00 HighErrorRate fires on order-service _(alerts)_

## Next steps

1. Recreate the stock_levels index in inventory-service (or roll back to v1.4.1).
2. Update OPS-31 with this RCA.

## Open questions

- Should order-service add a circuit breaker for inventory calls?
